title: Verkiezingsonderzoek Vrije Universiteit 1967
authors: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Sociaal-wetenschappelijk instituut, afd. politicologie, Nederlands instituut voor de publieke opinie en het marktonderzoek,  NIPO * Amsterdam (primary investigator)
descriptions: Attitude towards government / government spending and taxes / motivations for political preference / image of own party / floating voters / image of party previously voted for / ideological preferences / political participation / exposure to political tv-programs / confidence in political leaders / opinions on price policy / sense of political efficacy and political alienation / perception of the power structure / attitude to the political system / opinions on the relation between religion and politics / value preferences, freedom, equality, religion / perception of freedom / attitude to equality of income, of opportunities, of prestige / political interest and information / political problem solving / opinions on the war in Vietnam. Background variables: basic characteristics/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ social class/ politics/ religion/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
